title: Anthropic is courting lawyers to teach AI agents how to negotiate and strike deals like humans
script:
Anthropic is consulting law firms to figure out how AI agents should negotiate deals.
The company wants its AI to act on behalf of users in complex business agreements.
Lawyers are advising the lab on the nuances of how human negotiators handle friction and compromises.
This move signals a push to give software autonomous roles in commercial transactions.
Would you let an AI negotiate your next business contract?
